option_relations.rationale: Age-related cardiac conduction disease is a broad category of cardiac issues, while Vasovagal syncope is a specific type of syncope. There is no direct clinical relationship between the two as defined by the relation types.

Complete heart block (Third-degree AV block) is a severe cardiac conduction abnormality. Vasovagal syncope is a reflex-mediated syncope. They are distinct conditions with different etiologies and mechanisms.
Third-degree atrioventricular block is a specific type of heart block. Vasovagal syncope is a specific type of syncope. They are distinct conditions.
Trifascicular heart block is a complex cardiac conduction disorder. Vasovagal syncope is a reflex-mediated syncope. They are distinct conditions.
